scope: Raw IPv4/IPv6 read/write/readv/writev on retained original socket OFDs for UDP and IP transports without a native TCP byte capability. Preserve native TCP and existing byte-resource fast paths, common original raw ABI, captured input/output, original event waits and EPIPE task handoff.
method: Four independent processes each perform 1,000 checked 64-byte round trips; four Trames vCPUs; three unprofiled counterbalanced repeats plus one separate diagnostic repeat. Vector cases use two iovecs for one packet/frame; UDP requires one read of the entire packet and TCP assembles each checked frame across any short read. Setup/cleanup outside timer. Native ARM Linux runs the identical static musl ELF on six vCPUs and is stopped during Mac timing. macOS uses its native read/write/readv/writev APIs. Short TCP scalar and existing message controls show approximately eight percent increases; both are retained and followed up with 10,000 iterations and nine counterbalanced unprofiled samples. Longer medians are near equal. No universal native-speed, whole-app, Firefox or physical-iPad claim.

abi_cases: UDP two-vector gather/scatter remains one packet
count and signed-length errors use original raw helpers
bad later vector faults before send/dequeue
original scalar/vector receive destinations survive FD close/reuse and iovec edits
parked destination remap faults before dequeue
O_NONBLOCK live status and existing socket timeout
virtual TCP raw EPIPE saves terminal result through original owner handoff after numeric reuse
netlink raw I/O excludes before guest input import
validation.reuse: Full Apple kernel277 reused after the final cfg(test)-only single-slot wait assertion; the affected sixteen-combination case and strict checks rerun. Linux full277 includes the final assertion. Unchanged VFS/network/CPU/memory/graphics acceptance and guest inputs reused. No production source changes after builds or performance samples.

implementation.admission: Native TCP capability first; existing accepted shared byte OFDs next; only unsupported raw byte calls may accept a full original IP socket. No new membership lookup, allocation or publication guard on those existing accepted paths.
implementation.abi: Original scalar preflight factored once, original readv_parts, write_transport and writev_transport_mode used directly. Preserve caps, errors, empty records, one-packet gather/scatter and existing VFS access check after buffer import.
implementation.ownership: Accepted original SocketOperation, owned send bytes or original receive scatter ranges. Close/reuse and later iovec edits cannot substitute another source or destination.
implementation.concurrency: Existing per-accepted-call state and socket event/timer waits. No new global resource lock, resource/service thread, bus, busy polling, guest-memory fence or native permission policy. Raw writes gain no TCP-publication algorithm lock absent from original VFS.
implementation.task_effects: Virtual TCP EPIPE retains saved terminal result and full original OFD during original-task SIGPIPE handoff, without resending.

remaining: Task/job control, pending task signals and mount/proc ownership
Structural file/VM/task transitions and residual whole-process cohort joins
